fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide -run 'TestBuildText|TestReviewText' finds the delay-injection rule (inject a delay at the suspected race; never busy loops or parallel stress on the host) in both the build and review topics beside the unstable-CI rule; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestClaudeMDScopedTests finds the same rule in CLAUDE.md beside the unstable-CI reproduce-locally rule, with that rule unchanged
fields.statement: The rhiza-build and rhiza-review guide topics (so the rhiza-build and rhiza-review skills) and this repo's CLAUDE.md tell builders, verifiers, checks and fixers to reproduce a timing flake by injecting a delay at the suspected race, and never by busy loops, CPU stress or parallel stress runs on the shared host
